statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in jq 1.8.2, which bounds recursion in jvp_equal (MAX_EQUAL_DEPTH) and jvp_cmp (MAX_CMP_DEPTH) (NEWS.md 1.8.2). DHI ships Debian's jq 1.8.2-1 source rebuilt as 1.8.2-1+dhi1 (Debian tracker: sid fixed). The Debian trixie tracker still lists the 1.7.1 base, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped 1.8.2.

Fixed upstream in jq 1.8.2, whose raw-file loader (jv_load_file in jv_file.c) now breaks on an invalid jv after jv_string_append_buf, preventing the out-of-bounds write (NEWS.md 1.8.2). DHI ships Debian's jq 1.8.2-1 source rebuilt as 1.8.2-1+dhi1 (Debian tracker: sid fixed). The Debian trixie tracker still lists the 1.7.1 base, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped 1.8.2.

Fixed upstream in jq 1.8.2, which tightens the string-length overflow bound in jvp_string_append and jv_string_repeat and propagates invalid jv in jv_string_implode and f_string_implode (NEWS.md 1.8.2). The integer overflow is 32-bit-only; this image ships only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 (64-bit). DHI ships Debian's jq 1.8.2-1 source rebuilt as 1.8.2-1+dhi1 (Debian tracker: sid fixed). The Debian trixie tracker still lists the 1.7.1 base, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped 1.8.2.

Fixed upstream in jq 1.8.2, which bounds the recursive containment check with MAX_CONTAINS_DEPTH in jvp_contains (advisory GHSA-r7m6-x9c7-h69j; NEWS.md 1.8.2). Affects jq <= 1.8.1 only. DHI ships Debian's jq 1.8.2-1 source rebuilt as 1.8.2-1+dhi1 (Debian tracker: sid fixed, urgency unimportant/no-DSA). The Debian trixie tracker still lists the 1.7.1 base, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped 1.8.2.

Fixed upstream in jq 1.8.2 (limits recursive object merge depth in jv_object_merge_recursive to prevent stack exhaustion via the * operator; advisory GHSA-mg96-6h3q-g846). DHI ships Debian's jq 1.8.2-1 source rebuilt as 1.8.2-1+dhi1, ahead of trixie which still packages 1.7.1. The Debian trixie tracker records no fixed version, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped version.

CVE-2025-9403 is a reachable assertion (CWE-617) in run_jq_tests in jq_test.c, the jq test harness, which is not compiled into the shipped jq binary. It also affects only jq <= 1.6, whereas this ships 1.8.2-1+dhi1. The Debian trixie tracker records no fixed version, so scanners flag the suite regardless of the shipped version.
Assertion failure in testsuite, negligible security impact.

CVE-2024-23337 requires crafted input that would not be encountered in the typical temporalio-admin-tools usage context. The jq tool is used for JSON processing of known-good configuration and schema data.
